content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in St. Louis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for PMP candidacy. St. Louis professionals in Healthcare, Financial Services, Aerospace & Defense, and Manufacturing sectors frequently qualify. Review PMI's specific hour thresholds, then contact Granite PM Academy to validate your background before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous online sessions covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, domain knowledge, and exam strategy. All instruction is delivered nationwide via video conferencing; you study and participate from anywhere, on a schedule designed for working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, complete your official PMI PMP application and pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process. PMI reviews your credentials and issues eligibility confirmation before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll sit for the computer-based test and receive your results the same day; exam delivery is available across St. Louis and nationwide.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter PMI's standard 3-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or continuing education in project management. Renew your credential before expiration to keep the PMP active and demonstrate ongoing commitment to your profession.
